breakdown.description: The prescribed global horizontal point load is projected onto the local normal direction of the skew boundary
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to resolve the 5 kN load into the local normal direction of the skew boundary and apply only that normal component. The ground truth specifies applying the horizontal point load directly at the specified boundary point without any projection onto the local normal. The generated specification correctly states 'A horizontal point load of -5000 N is applied at the coordinate (1.1, 0.15) using a PointSource,' which matches the ground truth by keeping the load as a global horizontal force without any normal-direction projection.
